overview: 针对大语言模型智能体在处理超长周期（xLong-horizon）任务时面临的执行方差、高延迟导致的GPU闲置以及非线性分支带来的训练冗余问题，本文提出了QwenGyre框架。该框架通过在 rollout 和训练过程间弹性重分配 GPU 资源，并结合轨迹处理器进行路径去重与进度评估，旨在优化训练效率并提升模型性能。

highlights.text: QwenGyre 框架通过动态弹性分配 GPU 资源和轨迹重构去重技术，显著提升了处理超长周期任务的训练效率。
highlights.evidence: QwenGyre elastically reallocates GPUs between rollout and training without interrupting live executions, while its trajectory processor reconstructs branching histories, scores partial progress, and deduplicates redundant paths to bound training costs.

highlights.text: 在特定基准测试中，基于 Qwen 3.8 2.4T 模型，QwenGyre 在 48 步训练后使 NL2RepoBench 指标获得了 6.0% 的绝对提升。
highlights.evidence: Scaled to our flagship model, Qwen~3.8 2.4T, with 700K tokens per rollout, QwenGyre yields a 6.0% absolute gain on NL2RepoBench (52.5% to 58.5%) in 48 steps.

highlights.text: 实验结果表明，QwenGyre 在多个领域的训练任务中相较于 Colocate 和 Async 方法分别实现了最高 1.85 倍和 1.78 倍的加速。
highlights.evidence: Across our evaluations on diverse domains of training datasets, QwenGyre delivers up to 1.85times and 1.78times speedups over Colocate and Async, respectively.
